title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- TOUCH THE RIGHT PLACE

excerpt.rendered: “Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.” (Luke 8: 44)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy…

content.rendered: “Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.” (Luke 8: 44)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.At a time when the multitude kept following Jesus, pushing and touching Him in the process, the woman with the issue of blood showed up and touched the hem of Jesus’ garment, and was made whole. Others were simply touching and pushing and pressing, but this woman touched the hem of Jesus’ garment, she touched the right place, and she got the right results. She had the good fortune of touching the right place.Friend, I pray for you: may God give you the grace to touch the right places that will birth your results. May God bring you the right opportunities that will move you forward; may God grant you the right insight that will give you the right results; may God open your eyes to the right ideas and concepts that will push you into the next level of your destiny; may God show you the right steps to take so that you will rise higher than where you are.That woman could have joined others to touch Jesus randomly, and perhaps end up empty handed; but she touched the right place, and the result she needed came to her on a platter of grace. She touched the right place, and her result came with ease. As you touch the right places in destiny, your results will come with ease, and you will receive great rewards that you didn’t bargain for.Receive divine insight to discover the right places and touch same; receive divine wisdom to know where to ‘touch’ and when to ‘touch’ it. Your eyes shall be open to see the right relationships that will move you forward; God will stir you up to discover the clients, products, opportunities, jobs, businesses, etc that hold the key to your increase and next level; God will stir you to be precise as you shoot your arrows in destiny.Remember, not all that touched Jesus received results. Ask God to show you the right places to ‘touch’, and you shall have resounding results.Isaiah 30: 21 says: “And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.”Declare With Me: My eyes are open to see the right places I ought to touch, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
